title: Exploring the Impact of Urolithins A and B on Muscle Health: A Transcriptomic Analysis in Human Myotubes.

outcomes.name: Differentially expressed genes (RNA-seq)
outcomes.effect_text: UA and UB significantly modulated 1918 and 339 genes, respectively (FDR < 0.01; |log2FoldChange| > 0.32)

outcomes.name: Oxidative phosphorylation / mitochondrial pathway (UA)
outcomes.effect_text: UA predominantly affected oxidative phosphorylation, mitochondrial dysfunction

outcomes.name: NOTCH1 expression (RT-qPCR, UA)
outcomes.effect_text: UA-induced increases in NOTCH1 (5 μM, p = 0.0471)
